chunks: He (peace be upon him) was asked: Who is the most eloquent of the poets?

key_terms.أَشْعَرُ: Most eloquent or most fluent in speech

ai.seo_question: Who is considered the greatest poet according to Imam Ali (AS)?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) identifies Al-Akhtal as the greatest poet, a designation that reflects the Shia scholarly appreciation for poets who articulate theological truths and social justice with eloquence. This evaluation underscores the value placed on literary merit as a vehicle for conveying divine wisdom and communal identity within the Islamic tradition.
